name: Better WARP
description: Cloudflare WARP over AmneziaWG as a protocol of the subscription: add an inbound of the WARP protocol (panel build with it) and attach clients, and each gets WARP nodes in the same four forms as an AmneziaWG node (vpn://, amneziawg://, the older amneziawg:// link, .conf), with their own WARP device, a WARP+ license, and a check and an endpoint scanner (in Better Cores) to find the quickest endpoints. Without a WARP inbound it works from its own page.
author: AllIsA1
